title: Jahriyya revolt
text: The Jahriyya revolt of 1781 was a revolt involving sectarian violence between two suborders of the Naqshbandi Sufis – the Jahriyya Sufi Muslims and their rivals, the Khafiyya Sufi Muslims. This led to Qing intervention to stop the fighting between the two, which in turn led to a Jahriyya rebellion that China then crushed with the help of the Khufiyya (Khafiyya) Sufi Muslims.
